checkpoints.description: [1/5] 7-pass audit of Phase 1-2 Principles (P000-P004: Meta-Governance, Progressive Disclosure, Lifecycle Ordering, Empirical Grounding, Attentional Drift); [2/5] 7-pass audit of Phase 2-3 Principles (P005-P008: Cold-Start Sync, Disruption Checkpointing, Pre-flight Gating, Task Decomposition); [3/5] 7-pass audit of Phase 3 Principles (P009-P012: Pluggable Architecture/Host Portability, Performance Optimization, Zero-Friction Onboarding, Token Frugality); [4/5] 7-pass audit of Phase 4 Principles (P013-P016: Crash Resilience, Automated Test Coverage, Dogfooding/Chaos, Knowledge Synchronization); [5/5] 7-pass audit of Phase 5 Principles (P017-P019: Living Principle Sync, Automatic Git Workflow, Secret Hygiene), final cross-synthesis, and gate verification.

impact_assessment.why: Conduct comprehensive 7-pass analytical evaluation of all 20 principles to ensure semantic clarity, universal cross-LLM interpretability, mechanical robustness, and identify evolution vectors with impact/drawback analysis
impact_assessment.benefits: Exposes latent ambiguities, ensures all frontier and local models interpret principles identically, pinpoints potential loopholes, and establishes clear evolution roadmap with trade-off ledger
impact_assessment.risks: contract: audit ledger must maintain living doc link integrity; dependency: no new dependencies added; concurrency: state serialized through WAL ledger; state: task_ledger updated atomically
impact_assessment.mitigation: Record structured ledger in knowledge/principles_audit_ledger.md, verify 100% test pass rate, enforce core doc parity
